user_request: Include FAC in the actual accuracy, efficiency and parallel efficiency comparison.
hypothesis: Common complete FAC inputs isolate numerical assembly; independently optimized complete workflows reveal declared model differences and actual fixed-work scaling. Parallelism helps only when actual retained workloads outweigh overhead.

fixed.SE_VP_Breit: off for DC structure; any transverse panel separate
fixed.note: Complete existing frozen-config runner space, not a full physical convergence claim. Separate seven-config 37-level common-integral cases.

scopes: same fixed work strong scaling S_p=T_1/T_p, E_p=S_p/p
independent fixed-work throughput separate from algorithmic scaling

actual_process_threads_observer: Required for FAC OpenMP before accepting S/E; cap8 is process total, no env-only inference. Private child monotonic wait4 timing or blocking wait/watchdog, not timeout polling.
stopping: Reject unmatched/truncated targets and resource excess before allocations. Failed scientific gates invalidate corresponding timing comparison. Failed environment guards retain observations, no controlled performance conclusion. No silently raised tolerance or resource budget.
source_policy: Hash actual dirty source/frontend/build/library/config and loaded runtime before and after. Do not modify production sources or historical owners; root freezes evidence and adds a new FAC report version.
throughput_policy: Independent process throughput may be measured only with fixed complete task count and total8threads,24GiB reservation/8GiB headroom; distinguish throughput from strong scaling.
